name: dsh-v4-router
description: Reasoning-mode router for DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro: model-gated persona (w7/w6c) + Reasoning Protocol + per-turn near-field guidance (ports dsh-router-standard measured optimum).

interface.shortDescription: Model-gated w7/w6c persona + Reasoning Protocol + near-field guidance for V4 Flash/Pro
interface.longDescription: Ports the measured dsh-router-standard optimum to kimi-code: SessionStart records the session model; per user message, a near-field hook injects a fixed guidance text (complexity-dispatched). Flash sessions get the w7 persona with recall/anti-runaway anchors (P23: 96% routing, 100% completion); Pro sessions get w6c (P24: 100% routing, zero anchors). A user-mandated Reasoning Protocol (English thinking, starts with "We need...") is enforced at the top. Three-state control: auto/on/off.
